title: Race g could let the adopter start before a cancel it recorded as landing before adoption
resolution: A test-side recovery hold keeps the adopter from starting until the cancel commits, or until it is adopted and watching; both seeds reran.

title: The guard mutation proved only that the check is reached, not that a wrong parent is rejected
resolution: Unit tests reject a test-side parent and another worker's supervisor beside a positive control; they fail when the guard is bypassed.

title: The macOS summary left network changes out of the open Connectivity parts
resolution: Network changes are named among the open parts.

title: The design said the macOS guard covers races c and h, though race g uses it too
resolution: The design names races c, g, and h.

title: Race g's cancel before adoption reached the worker only after the adopter started, so that path never ran
resolution: The held check answers once that the supervisor lives, after the worker journaled the cancel, so the watch files the cancel file before the next check adopts; the scenario checks the file existed at adoption; both seeds reran.

title: Race g's uncertain wait was five times the measured work and its test bound was below the sum of its waits
resolution: The uncertain wait is 90 s and the test bound 400 s; verification.md records race g's measured duration.

title: The proposal and spec delta left race g out of the macOS guard's races
resolution: Both name races h, g, and c after the start.

title: The macOS guard accepted a child of a supervisor in any mode, though the spec requires a launch supervisor
resolution: The guard accepts only launching supervisors; a unit test rejects an adopter's child and fails with the old filter.

title: The supervisor match on the data root was a prefix match that a sibling data root passed
resolution: The match needs the data root followed by a slash; a unit test with a shared prefix fails with the old match.

title: The guard's unit tests leaked processes when a start failed and could hang on a parent that died
resolution: Each family is tracked as soon as it spawns, the start races the parent's exit, and the suite has a 30 s bound.

title: Linux process listings kept NUL separators, so a supervisor match on its mode found nothing there
resolution: The /proc command line reads with spaces, as ps prints it, with a unit test.

title: The generated checks said no review pass yet and the Checks paragraph claimed only one later commit
resolution: make record regenerated the part from the new make verify log, and the paragraph names the commits after it.

title: The design still named the start-only wrapper instead of the one that also holds recoveries
resolution: The design names HeldSupervision with its start and recovery holds.

title: The Linux paths of the shared scenario helpers were not run on Linux
resolution: Recorded as a limitation in verification.md: no Linux host run in this change; the Linux make verify runs at promotion to main.
